title: Permitted obstructions
previewText: The underlying permitted obstructions to height and setback allowances as set forth in Sections 23-41, 24-51 and 33-42 (Permitted Obstructions) shall be modified to allow energy infrastructure equipment and accessory mechanical equipment on the roof of a building, or any other structures supporting such systems, as permitted obstructions, without limitations.
